meta.title: TAU AI Club, Tel Aviv University
meta.description: Weekly meetups, Zero to Hero workshops and talks from industry. Cohort 02, 2026–27.

home.icebreakersBody: Before each meetup we'll pair you up for a quick 1:1 chat with someone from the cohort. By the end of the year, everyone knows everyone.
home.aboutLead: Weekly meetups with founders, investors and AI leaders from the industry. Hands-on workshops. A community that builds.
home.about1Body: Founders, investors and AI leaders from the industry, every Wednesday.
home.about2Body: Zero to Hero: laptops open, and you leave with something that runs.
home.about3Body: A small cohort, about 40 places, and initiatives members take on for the club.
home.bandInBody: Your profile, your meetups and the workshop materials are in your personal area.
home.bandOutBody: Follow us for open events and to hear first when the next cohort opens.
home.aboutTagline: Building the next generation of AI leaders

calendarFeed.description: Every meetup of the TAU AI Club season. Updates on its own.

auth.loginBody: Members of the cohort log in with the email on the club list. We'll email you a 6-digit code.
auth.errorCancelled: Sign-in was cancelled. You can try again.
auth.errorFailed: Something went wrong signing you in. Try again in a moment.
auth.errorUnavailable: Sign-in isn't switched on for this site yet.
auth.membersOnlyBody: This part of the site is for members of the cohort. If you registered with a different email, sign out and sign in with that one, and we'll see you inside.
auth.membersOnlyGuest: Club members log in with the email on the club list.
auth.membersOnlyFollow: Not in the cohort? Follow us on Instagram for open events and the next cohort.
auth.welcomeTitle: Hi {name}, welcome to the AI Club
auth.welcomeBody: You're signed in. From here you can see what's open to members of the cohort.
auth.membersOnlyFollowBody: On Instagram we post events that are open to everyone, and when the next cohort opens.
auth.codeSent: If this email is on the club list, a code is on its way. Didn't get one? Contact the club.
auth.codeHint: The code only works for a short while. Check your spam folder too.
auth.errorCode: That code didn't work. Check it, or ask for a new one.
auth.errorExpired: That took too long. Enter your email again for a new code.
auth.errorThrottled: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes and try again.
auth.notInCohort: Not in the cohort yet? Follow us on Instagram to hear when the next one opens.

admin.membersBody: Only emails on this list can sign in. Changes apply on the next request.
admin.name: Name
admin.removeConfirm: Remove {name} from the club? Their access ends right away.
admin.importTitle: Fill in from Luma or a flyer
admin.importBody: Paste the event's Luma link, or upload the flyer image. The form below is filled in as a draft for you to check. It's free: nothing is sent to an AI service, and nothing is published.
admin.errorEmailTaken: That email is already on the list.
admin.errorLastAdmin: You can't remove or demote the last admin.
admin.speakersBody: Create a single-use link and send it to the speaker. They choose what to share. Email and phone are visible to members only; LinkedIn is public only if the speaker opts in.
admin.speaker: Speaker
admin.linkReady: The link is ready. It's only shown now, so copy it:
admin.eventsBody: Every event in the season, drafts included. Saving updates the public site right away.
admin.speakerCount: {n, plural, =0 {no speakers} one {# speaker} other {# speakers}}
admin.eventFormBody: Guests only see published events. A draft and its speakers stay hidden.
admin.slugHint: Lower-case letters, digits and dashes. Changing it breaks old links.
admin.timeZoneHint: Times are Israel time (Asia/Jerusalem), whatever your computer's timezone.
admin.speakersOrderHint: Speakers show in this order. Leave a slot empty to skip it.
admin.deleteEventConfirm: Permanently delete “{name}”? Its line-up is removed too. This can't be undone.
admin.errorTime: Enter a start and end date and time.
admin.errorEndsBeforeStarts: The end has to be after the start.
admin.errorDuplicateSpeaker: The same speaker is listed twice.
admin.errorInUse: It's still in use, so it can't be changed or removed.
admin.venuesBody: Places events happen. Deleting a venue sets its events to “venue TBD”.
admin.eventCount: {n, plural, =0 {no events} one {# event} other {# events}}
admin.deleteVenueConfirm: Delete {name}? {n, plural, =0 {No events use it.} one {# event will show “venue TBD”.} other {# events will show “venue TBD”.}}
admin.speakerProfilesBody: Public speaker profiles. A speaker shows on the site only once they're on a published event. Contact details are collected separately, under Speaker contacts.
admin.deleteSpeakerConfirm: Delete {name}'s profile? This can't be undone.
admin.errorSpeakerOnEvent: This speaker is on an event's line-up. Remove them from the event first.
admin.errorPhotoHost: The photo has to be an https link on Supabase Storage (*.supabase.co).
admin.contactsEmpty: No speakers on this session yet. Pick speakers above and save, then you can ask them for contact details.
admin.missingContacts: {n, plural, one {# speaker without contact details} other {# speakers without contact details}}
admin.flyerErrorType: That file isn't a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
admin.flyerErrorFailed: Reading the flyer didn't work. Try again, or fill in the form by hand.
admin.flyerErrorPhoto: A speaker photo couldn't be saved. Try again, or skip the photo.
admin.flyerErrorSpeaker: A new speaker couldn't be created. Check their name, or pick an existing speaker.
admin.flyerVenueNoMatch: (not a saved venue; added as a venue note)
admin.flyerCropLabel: Crop for face {n}. Drag, or use the arrow keys; + and - resize.
admin.flyerNoFaces: No faces found on the flyer. You can add photos later under Speakers.
admin.flyerApplyHint: New speakers are created now; the event is saved only when you save the form.
admin.flyerPrefilled: Filled in from the import. The marked fields came from it: check every field, then save. It saves as a draft.
admin.lumaImportHint: Most accurate: title, date, time, place and the cover image come straight from the event page.
admin.flyerHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 10 MB. Read in your browser: the date, time, link, and venues and speakers already on the site. Titles are offered as suggestions.
admin.importFromLuma: From the Luma page. Check everything before you fill the form.
admin.importFromFlyer: Read off the flyer. Scanning makes mistakes, so check everything before you fill the form.
admin.importNoSpeakers: No speakers from the site were found. Add them below, or later in the form.
admin.importFacesFound: {n, plural, one {One face found} other {# faces found}}: pick one under a speaker to save it as their photo.
admin.importErrorForbidden: Only admins can import events. Sign in again if this looks wrong.
admin.lumaErrorUrl: That isn't a Luma event link (lu.ma/… or luma.com/…).
admin.lumaErrorNotFound: Luma says that event doesn't exist. Check the link.
admin.lumaErrorNoData: The Luma page had no event details we could read. Fill in the form by hand.
admin.lumaErrorFailed: Luma didn't answer (or blocked the request). Try again later, or fill in the form by hand.
admin.flyerCaption: Text printed next to this photo
admin.flyerNoCaption: No text found next to this photo.
admin.speakerFromFlyerHint: Read a flyer in your browser, then pick the person. Their name, role, company and photo fill this form; check them, then save. Nothing is saved until you do.
admin.speakerFlyerFilled: Filled in from the flyer. Check every field, then save.
admin.speakerFlyerNoFaces: No faces found on this flyer.
admin.csvImportBody: Columns: email, full_name, role (member or admin). An email already on the list is updated, a new one is added. One bad row stops the whole import.

speakerForm.title: Hi {name}
speakerForm.intro: Thanks for speaking at the TAU AI Club. You can share contact details with us, and you decide on each one separately. Anything you don't tick isn't stored.
speakerForm.shareEmail: Share my email with club members
speakerForm.sharePhone: Share my phone number with club members
speakerForm.shareLinkedin: Share my LinkedIn profile with club members
speakerForm.linkedinPublic: Also show it on the public site

speakerForm.consent: I agree that the club stores the details I ticked and shows them as I chose. I can ask for them to be deleted at any time.
speakerForm.expires: This link works until {date} and can be used once.
speakerForm.doneBody: Your details are saved. If you want to change or delete them, write to us and we'll send a new link.
speakerForm.invalidBody: It may have been used already or expired. Ask us for a new one.

speakerForm.errorPhone: That phone number doesn't look right.
speakerForm.errorLinkedin: Please use a LinkedIn profile link (https://www.linkedin.com/...).
speakerForm.errorExpired: This link is no longer valid.
speakerForm.visibleMembers: Visible only to signed-in cohort members.
speakerForm.signoff: The TAU AI Club team, Tel Aviv University

profile.title: My profile
profile.body: Your profile is visible to members of the cohort only. Guests never see it.
profile.photoHint: Any photo from your phone works; we'll shrink it for you. Only club members see it.
profile.linksHint: https links only. GitHub must be a github.com profile.
profile.errorYear: Pick a year from the list.
profile.errorLinks: One of the links isn't valid. Use full https addresses.
profile.errorPhotoType: That file isn't a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
profile.attendanceCount: {n, plural, =0 {No meetups attended yet this season.} one {You came to one meetup this season.} other {You came to # meetups this season.}}
profile.attendanceHint: From the check-in at the door (Luma). Only you and the club's admins see this.
profile.contactBody: Only signed-in members can ever see these, and only what you choose to show. Both start hidden.
profile.sharePhone: Show my phone to other members
profile.shareEmail: Show my contact email to other members
profile.errorPhone: That phone number doesn't look right.
profile.errorContactEmail: That email address doesn't look right.
profile.privacyNote: Other members see only what you choose to share.

attendance.title: Attendance from Luma
attendance.body: After the meetup, open the event on Luma → Guests → Export CSV and upload the file here. Members are matched by any of their emails. Guests who aren't members are only counted: their names and emails are never saved.
attendance.pickHint: Read in your browser; only email, registration status and check-in time are sent. Uploading again replaces this event's attendance.
attendance.errorEmpty: That file has no guests in it.
attendance.errorNoEmail: No email column found. Is this Luma's guest export?
attendance.errorLoad: Some attendance data couldn't be loaded.
attendance.countCheckedIn: {n, plural, one {# member checked in} other {# members checked in}}
attendance.countNoShow: {n, plural, one {# member registered but didn't come} other {# members registered but didn't come}}
attendance.countRegistered: {n, plural, one {# member registered (event not over yet)} other {# members registered (event not over yet)}}
attendance.countGuests: {n, plural, one {# guest who isn't a member} other {# guests who aren't members}} ({in} checked in): counted, not saved
attendance.countIgnored: {n} of {total} rows skipped (declined, waitlist or no email)
attendance.saveHint: Replaces anything imported for this event before.
attendance.statsHint: {members, plural, one {# member} other {# members}} on the list, {checkedIn} of them checked in; {guestsIn} non-member guests checked in.
attendance.noMembers: No members on this guest list.
attendance.none: No attendance imported for this event yet.
attendance.seasonBody: Who came to each meetup this season, from the Luma check-ins. Import each event's guest list on its page.
attendance.exportHint: The grid below as a spreadsheet: names and statuses, no emails.
attendance.gridCaption: Members by meetup: checked in or not
attendance.gridLegend: The rate counts only meetups imported from Luma.
attendance.memberBody: Meetups this season that have a Luma import.
attendance.memberNoData: No meetups imported yet this season.

content.lecturesBody: Talks from people building with AI. Every lecture gets a short public summary; members also get the full write-up: the summary, learning goals and key takeaways.
content.summaryComing: The summary goes up after the lecture.
content.lockedTitle: The full write-up is for club members
content.lockedBody: Members get the full summary, the learning goals, the key takeaways and the original PDF.
content.soonBody: The members area isn't open yet. Once it is, club members can read the full summary, the learning goals and the key takeaways here.
content.soonBodyWorkshop: The members area isn't open yet. Once it is, club members will find the prep checklist, the key commands, the exercises and the resources here.
content.lockedOutsider: This Google account isn't on the club's list.
content.loadError: The members' part couldn't be loaded. Refresh the page to try again.
content.hebrewOnlyHint: This part hasn't been translated yet, so here is the Hebrew original.
content.workshopsBody: Zero to Hero: hands-on evenings building with Claude. For each one: what to prepare, the key commands, exercises and resources.
content.comingSoon: Coming after the workshop: Oz will share it after the session.
content.adminBody: Write each event's sections in Markdown, Hebrew first. Each section has its own audience and is either a draft or published.
content.editorEnHint: Leave empty to show the Hebrew text, marked "Hebrew only for now".
content.errorTooLong: That's too long (60,000 characters at most).
content.markdownHint: Markdown: # heading, **bold**, *italic*, - list, - [ ] checklist, `code`, ``` code block ```, [link](https://…). HTML isn't allowed and shows as text.
content.notSaved: Not created yet: saving creates it.
content.filesBody: PDFs that members can download. Up to 3 MB each.
content.fileDeleteConfirm: Delete this file? Members won't be able to download it any more.
